# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- For MCP diagnostic tracing in SmartStandards.AiSupport, the user-approved MyLogEventKind range is 75300–75399 (75.3xx), not 74000–74099.
- When investigation tools stall or are canceled, do not repeatedly pursue the same exploration strategy; prioritize implementing the approved, scoped changes with direct file tools and concise progress reports.
